verdict.rationale: Obsidian stores notes as local plain-text Markdown files with no proprietary lock-in, explicitly marketed as future-proof and portable to other apps, and community reports corroborate that notes are just text files that outlive the app. missing for 10: no independent hands-on test of a full 'export and leave' migration workflow, and the newer Canvas format is JSON rather than pure Markdown, adding a minor caveat.
